studies.headline: Merops hirundineus changes direction depending on which five years of the second atlas are used, so this project reports no change for it.
studies.detail: Against 2008-2012 the change is -0.002; against 2019-2023 it is +0.136. The method note fixed in advance that a species which flips sign between the two windows carries no result.
studies.caveat: Two atlases thirty years apart, so this is a before and after and not a trend: nothing here is per decade. South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini only, and only where volunteers atlassed twice. Nothing here says why.

studies.headline: Torgos tracheliotus occupies about as much of the region as it did thirty years ago.
studies.value: -0.013 in the probability a cell is occupied
studies.detail: Occupancy 0.182 in 1987-1991 against 0.168 in 2008-2012, over 496 quarter-degree cells atlassed at least 20 times in both epochs. Detection was estimated separately in each epoch at 0.185 and 0.077.
studies.caveat: Two atlases thirty years apart, so this is a before and after and not a trend: nothing here is per decade. South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini only, and only where volunteers atlassed twice. Nothing here says why.
